  intro N _ v w
  have hrev (a b : M6.Physical.Block N) :
      M6.Physical.dot N (fun i => a (-i)) (fun i => b (-i)) =
        M6.Physical.dot N a b := by
    change (∑ i : ZMod N, a (-i) * b (-i)) = ∑ i : ZMod N, a i * b i

    change (∑ i : ZMod N, a (-i) * b (-i)) = ∑ i : ZMod N, a i * b i

        ∀ h : M6.Physical.Block N,
